news.title: Aureka adds gold processing firepower to Victorian push
news.snippet: Aureka Ltd has nominated a 30-year veteran metallurgist to its board ahead of a pivotal, low-cash deal that will deliver a producing Victorian gold mine and mill.

news.title: Manhattan opens up 1.25km Canadian gold corridor at Jaws
news.snippet: Manhattan Gold has hit 21.34m at 1.72g/t gold from a step-out hole in Canada, extending the strike at its Jaws prospect to 1.25km, with results for 10 holes remaining.

news.title: Rio2 launches major drill assault at Peruvian copper mine
news.snippet: Rio2 has launched a 33,870m drilling assault at its burgeoning Condestable copper mine in Peru, with plans to drill its emerging Canadian tungsten asset locked and loaded for early next year.

news.title: Auric hits high-grade gold beyond WA Munda pit shell
news.snippet: Auric Mining has hit 4m at 10.49g/t gold in drilling west of its planned WA Munda pit, alongside grade control drilling, which jagged15m at 5.56g/t gold near surface.

news.title: How McDonald’s is grappling with the Ozempic boom
news.snippet: The company synonymous with super-sized everything is revamping its menu for an era of slimming waist lines.

news.title: Sarytogan nails 452m of continuous copper in Kazakhstan
news.snippet: Sarytogan Graphite has bored a massive 452m copper intercept from surface at its Ilksan prospect in Kazakhstan, confirming a large-scale porphyry system at the project.
